text:
maya_sales: Quick sync: Prospect NorthSky wants a POC with committed capacity. They expect bursty campaigns: steady ~320 qps, peaks ~1.6k qps, mixed chat+embed. Need sizing, pricing framing, and a preheat plan (they care about cold-start p99).
diego_sre: Do we know model & region? AZ constraints?
zhou_eng: They're pinning to redwood/llm-7b-quantized in us-west-2. Chat avg 140 tokens, embeds 512 dim. Peak concurrency ~1000.
clare_solution: Pricing ask: a clear reserved slot monthly price + capped burst pool credits. They want a clause preventing surprise billing during scheduled campaigns.
maya_sales: Also legal asks for KMS + audit logs for HIPAA. Private option preferred.
diego_sre: Sizing quick math: effective mixed throughput ~62 qps/GPU on A100-80. For steady 320 -> 6 GPUs reserved (round up). Peak 1600 -> ~26 GPUs total. Recommend reserve 6 + burst up to 20.
zhou_eng: Recommend autoscale: min_nodes=6, max_nodes=26, scale_up_cooldown=60s, scale_down_cooldown=600s. Include fallback to llm-7b-q4f16 with 10% canary when bursting.
clare_solution: Offer pricing lanes: monthly fee for 6 reserved GPUs + burst credit pool priced per GPU-hour + optional one-time preheat block (6 GPU-hours) at a fixed cost.
diego_sre: Call out operational caveats: p99 SLA assumes reserved capacity + warmed KV. Cold cache during an abrupt spike may breach p99. Add preheat runbook and KV-hit dashboards.
maya_sales: ops-bot create ticket and I'll book call with NorthSky for Wed 9am PT.
ops-bot: Created ticket #PR-9999: "NorthSky POC 1: sizing + preheat runbook + KMS wording" assigned to zhou_eng, diego_sre, due 2026-04-05. :white_check_mark:
zhou_eng: I'll draft a one-page engineering appendix with throughput per-GPU table (6/10/18/26 nodes), expected tail latency, and preheat token estimate (~160M tokens -> ~3 GPU-hrs region).
clare_solution: I'll convert that into three billing scenarios (steady month, campaign week, worst-case sustained).
maya_sales: Thanks team. I'll include the Private/KMS addendum in the proposal and loop Legal.
